content:
maya: Heads-up — we hit a weird race where multiple assessors requested ephemeral RBAC at the exact start of the PT window and our KMS proxy throttled, causing some evidence uploads to fail. Need a quick plan for retest ordering and a mitigation so this doesn't cascade.
raj: ugh. saw the log spikes. which KMS proxy? staging or prod? any failed grants logged with request IDs?
maya: staging first. failures show: `KMSProxy:429` + `grant_timeout` in the auth logs. attached snippets in the ticket: PT-7182. some assessors retried and created duplicate artifacts.
leah: can we enqueue grants instead of parallelizing at T0? i.e., give ephemeral creds in a jittered backoff so the proxy doesn't blow up — small window per team.
sam: +1. also recommend tombstone duplicates on ingest if same artifact checksum arrives within 5m. that will avoid duplicate evidence in the readroom.
ops-oncall: we can add a short mutex in the gate process: `acquire-global-ephemeral-lock` then release after grant. low risk, trivial change. rollout on staging 10m.
maya: ok, plan: (1) add jittered grant logic (2) add dedupe-at-ingest by sha256 + auth-entity (3) schedule retest queue in PT tracker. who owns each?
raj: i'll own the jittered grant change and the lock. will push a small lambda to gate grants behind SQS with 100ms jitter. aim: 2h patch, test in staging.
leah: i'll own ingest dedupe and update the evidence pipeline — will add a graceful drop + audit entry: `evidence.dedupe=true`.
sam: i'll coordinate assessor comms + retest queue. suggestion: assign retest slots in 10-min blocks to each assessor id to avoid simultaneous burst. update PT-7182 with the slot plan.
pt-bot: Reminder: relevant playbooks -> /playbooks/pt-access.md ; next available retest window auto-scheduler is enabled if ticket label `retest-queue` exists.
maya: sample command for ephemeral role request (staging) i'll post for Raj to test:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging-auth.redwood.ai/ephemeral-roles \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"assessor_id":"A123","scope":"readroom:staging","ttl":600}'
```
leah: for ingest dedupe, i'll add a pre-ingest hook (pseudocode):
```python
if exists_in_store(sha256, assessor_id, within_seconds=300):
    log.audit("duplicate_evidence", {...})
    return 409
else:
    proceed_upload()
```
ops-oncall: audit logging: ensure KMS grant failures are forwarded to splunk with `error_category:ephemeral_grant` and include request_id for correlation.
sam: comms: emailing assessors now to say we will stagger access at T0 and to re-upload any artifacts with `--force` flag if they hit 409 after 1 retry.
maya: retest queue: Sam pls add entries to PT-7182 with assessor id + preferred slot. we will treat queue as canonical for gating retest permissions.
raj: started PR -> `grant-jitter-sqs` branch. will flip a feature flag in staging for 30m test window.
leah: created ingest dedupe PR and added audit event `evidence.duplicate_detected`. staging running.
maya: ops-oncall, can you confirm Splunk dashboard will show counts for `ephemeral_grant:failed` and `evidence.duplicate_detected` by assessor id? we want visibility before we flip in prod.
ops-oncall: will add the widgets. ETA 45m.
pt-bot: automation note: when PRs are merged, please tag the PT ticket with `ops-ready` so the scheduler can release retest slots.
sam: thanks — i'll hold off on assigning prod retest slots until we confirm staging metrics. if staging looks good, target prod flip tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
maya: perfect. risk call: if KMS proxy still saturates after jitter, fallback is to increase proxy concurrency and enable temporary rate-limiter per-assessor. escalate if we hit >5% grant errors in staging.
raj: acknowledged. posting PR link in the ticket. running small load test now.
maya: closing action items summary: Raj = grant jitter + lock; Leah = ingest dedupe + audit; Ops = splunk widgets; Sam = assessor comms + retest queue updates. everyone ping here when done. :thumbsup:
